newsitem.title: USA: Christiana Total Logistic unit profit down.
newsitem.headline: Christiana Total Logistic unit profit down.

text.p: Christiana Cos Inc said Total Logistic Control, its principal subsidiary, had first quarter earnings of $503,000, down from $1,072,000 a year ago.
Revenues for the unit rose three percent to $20.5 million in the fiscal first quarter ended September 30.
The drop in Total Logistic earnings reflected a 50 percent drop in vegetable freezing and processing volume this year due to both poor harvest yeields and fewer regional customers.

The subsidiary also invested $14 million to build two large warehouses that are now operational. Capacity utilization of these facilities is rapidly increasing and is expected to near full occupancy in the second quarter.

In real estate, Christiana said 10 home sales were completed in the first quarter contributing net earnings of $173,000 compared with the sale of 14 homes last year which generated net earnings of $512,000.

Equity in earnings of Energy Ventures Inc in the first quarter totaled $890,000, up from $404,000 reported for the same period last year. Christiana owns 1,948,731 shares of EVI representing an 8.8 percent ownership interest.
Earlier, Christiana reported earnings for the first quarter of $0.21 a share, down from $0.32 a year ago.
